rule: ALL of: (1) rv144_dev.auc.P_RMS.fit paired-bootstrap difference vs polyICSFlow clipped has a 95% lower bound > 0 (clipped detection is trivially beatable: it calls 36/36 placebos); (2) sim.spearman.rare_weak.RMS_mean.fit difference vs polyICSFlow unclipped has a 95% lower bound > 0 (the meaningful comparison is magnitude ranking); (3) sim.auc.rare_weak.P_RMS.fit difference vs polyICSFlow clipped >= 0 (point estimate; on the simulation clipped detection is not trivial); (4) every sim.cov90 guard passes. (5) the same (1) on RV144 test, run once with --test.
